_synthetic: FICTIONAL DATA for a product prototype. Not a real study, drug, sponsor or patient.

statisticalLanguageRules.requires: a p-value fact below its alpha in the same sentence
statisticalLanguageRules.message: 'Significant' implies a statistical test. Cite a p-value below alpha, or say 'more frequent' / 'numerically higher'.
Causal language is not allowed in results sections. Use 'considered related by the investigator'.
'Trend' is only allowed when a pre-specified trend analysis exists in the SAP.

statisticalLanguageRules.requires: every numeral produced by a slot
statisticalLanguageRules.message: A numeral appears in generated prose outside a slot. The model must never write numbers.
